Features
--------
- Thread-safe via a re-entrant lock (RLock), so methods that call
  other locked methods remain safe.
- Bounded size with true LRU eviction (most recently used entries
  are kept, least recently used are evicted).
- Per-entry TTL: each entry may have its own expiry time, falling
  back to a default TTL.
- Supports `get`, `set`, `delete`, `clear`, `__len__`,
  `__contains__`, and a `get_or_create` helper for atomic
  compute-if-absent semantics.
- Statistics tracking (hits, misses, evictions, expiries).

Example
-------
>>> cache = TTLCache(max_size=2, default_ttl=60)
>>> cache.set("a", 1)
>>> cache.get("a")
1
>>> "a" in cache
True
